cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the 2024 personal data proclamation covers personal data in general. Fayda's hosting on the government cloud (ETH-004) places nothing without such a rule.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-08: a 2024 deck says Fayda runs on the local government cloud (ETH-004), but with no rule on state data in force hosting places nothing. Digital Ethiopia 2030 sets a sovereign national cloud as a goal (ETH-002), so stage 2.
